listing.name: Urban Chaos: Riot Response (Urban Chaos Riot Response Burner Edition)
listing.summary: An experimental Urban Chaos: Riot Response port with Windows release and limited Linux compatibility testing. The Windows 0.07 ZIP supplies BurnerEditionSetup.exe to import and check your own supported original-Xbox ISO, prepare data and shaders, then launch the game. Keep GameData when following upstream replacement instructions. Windows 10/11 x64 needs Direct3D 12. The newer 0.07.5 Linux patch runs the same Windows player through Proton/Wine and is not a native Linux player. Spanish packaging and shader corrections are documented, while clean source/build status and broader gameplay remain limited. Exact accepted game revision/hashes and BIOS/firmware needs are unconfirmed. You and the project manage version changes; Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
